_help: The voice-over, one entry per scene id (see storyboard.json). 'text' is read in the 16:9 video, 'text_short' in the 9:16 and 1:1 videos (which are under 30 seconds). Edit the words and run: make-demo.ps1 -Steps render. Each scene lasts at least as long as its sentence, rounded up to whole bars of the music.

hook.text: A free translator that runs on your own PC.

text.text: Type, and it translates on your PC. No internet, no account.
text.text_short: Type, and it translates on your PC.

meeting.text: In a video call? Turn on captions, and Owl-L translates them live, speaker by speaker.

popup.text: Select text anywhere, press Control C twice, and see the translation.
popup.text_short: Select text, press Control C twice.

capture.text: Text in a picture or a video? Draw a box, and it is translated.
capture.text_short: Or translate text on the screen.

live.text: Subtitles in a video? Translated live.

docs.text: Translate Word, PowerPoint, Excel and PDF files. The formatting stays.

write.text: Fix grammar or change the tone, with a small AI on your PC.

offline.text: No internet needed. Nothing leaves your PC.

outro.text: Owl-L. Free, open source, for Windows. Find it on GitHub.
outro.text_short: Owl-L. Free and open source. Find it on GitHub.
